articles.summary: PARAMUS, N.J., March 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alexander’s, Inc. (NYSE: ALX) announced today that it has entered into an agreement to sell its Rego Park I property to Northwell Health, Inc. The gross purchase price is $235.5 million and the net proceeds will be $202 million.
articles.title: Alexander’s to Sell Rego Park I for Net Proceeds of $202 Million
